title: 2024 Shanghai Marathon results and finish rate (Shanghai Daily / shio.gov.cn)
publisher: 上海市人民政府新闻办公室（Shine/上海日报英文版）
claims: The 2024 Shanghai Marathon drew 38,000 participants in the full marathon and mini marathon combined, and more than 98 percent completed their races.
Men's full marathon: Samsom Amare (Eritrea) won in 2:06:26, followed by Titus Kipruto (Kenya) 2:06:30 and Solomon Kirwa Yego (Kenya) 2:06:34.
Women's full marathon: Bekelech Gudeta Borecha (Ethiopia) won in 2:25:21, followed by Sisay Meseret Gola (Ethiopia) 2:25:29 and Tejitu Siyum (Ethiopia) 2:26:28.
Domestic men's champion Wu Xiangdong ran 2:09:31; domestic women's champion Zhang Deshun ran 2:26:39.
The 2024 race introduced a speed wheelchair discipline with about 20 participants; Luo Xingchuan won the men's wheelchair in 1:32:09 and Chen Xiaochun won the women's in 1:51:25.
2024 was Shanghai's first year as a candidate race for the Abbott World Marathon Majors; the article reported planned inspections in 2025 and 2026 and possible Major recognition in 2027.
Organisers improved the route for wheelchair access by avoiding sharp curves and narrow roads, with five barrier-free toilets along the way.
The organisers announced the 2025 Shanghai Marathon would be held on 30 November 2025, with registration opening no later than June.
